segments: Most recommendation engines are a model guessing. This one is measured.
You post up to fifty catalogue items and the shopper's context.
A customer's pool went cloudy after heavy rain. Which three products go in front of them?
Clarifier, point six nine. Filter cartridge, point five six. Leaf net, point five four. Real cosine similarity, on real embeddings.
And it tells you what it is not: semantic similarity, not purchase-intent data.
Ten cents a recommendation. Vela Recs.
